mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.group_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_asset_group_ref r INNER JOIN marketing_template_file f ON f.id = r.file_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND (f.asset_scope IS NULL OR f.asset_scope = #{scope}) WHERE r.group_id = g.id AND r.scope = #{scope}) AS asset_count FROM resource_asset_group g WHERE g.scope = #{scope} ORDER BY g.group_name, g.id
